title: Understanding MSE on Training Data
text: When you add a new feature to a model, especially one that is a transformation of an existing feature, think about how it might affect the model's ability to fit the training data. Consider how adding more parameters can change the model's flexibility.

title: Effect of Adding a Feature
text: What happens to the model's flexibility when you add a new feature?

title: Model Complexity and Training MSE
text: Adding a feature can increase the model's complexity. A more complex model might fit the training data better, but it could also lead to overfitting. Think about how this affects the MSE on the training data.

title: Impact on Training MSE
text: If a model becomes more complex, what is a possible effect on the MSE of the training data?
